finish_summary: 1) bulk_discount_percent: mapping incorrect; 50 units returns 5% instead of 10%. 2) parse_coupon: does not ignore surrounding whitespace or case-insensitive, raising ValueError for valid codes like "save20" and "   SaVe30  ". 3) Cart.remove_item: fails to delete item when quantity reaches exactly zero; keeps entry with quantity 0. 4) Cart.total shipping calculation uses subtotal instead of amount after coupon (though test only failed on coupon parsing).
